basics.name: Erfan Eivazi
basics.label: Software Engineer
basics.summary:
Senior Software Engineer with 8+ years of experience in backend-oriented system design and development.
 Skilled in building scalable and maintainable systems using microservices, clean architecture, and modern .NET technologies.
 Deeply involved in code quality practices, including code reviews, refactoring, and enforcing engineering standards.
 Experienced in working across multiple products, designing cross‑service integrations, and contributing to CI/CD workflows in Agile/Scrum environments.

work.summary: A company specializing in engineering simulation and analysis software for gas pipeline networks, leveraging web-based GIS technology
highlights: Lead Backend Developer for SGN project, a web-based GIS engineering software for designing, analyzing, and simulating gas pipeline networks, handling dynamic and static pressure-flow analysis.
Spearheaded server-side development using .NET 5+, C#, implementing Clean Architecture and CQRS Pattern for robust and maintainable backend services.
Designed and developed microservices architecture, utilizing NestJS, TypeORM, and RabbitMQ for efficient inter-service communication and asynchronous processing.
Managed and optimized MSSQL Server databases, leveraging LINQ for data access and manipulation.
Developed and integrated frontend components using Angular, TypeScript, RxJS, and Kendo UI, ensuring seamless user experience.
Implemented and utilized GIS functionalities and OGC Standards (WFS, WMS, WMTS) with OpenLayers for spatial data visualization and analysis.
Proficient in DevOps practices with Azure DevOps for CI/CD pipelines and collaborative development.
Experience with GeoServer for managing and publishing geospatial data.
Techs: C# | .Net Core | MSSQL Server | Microservices | NestJS | Angular | GIS

work.summary: Web and Mobile Solutions Provider Company
highlights: Designed and Implemented a Multi-Branch CRM System (ParadiseHub): Led the end-to-end development of a comprehensive CRM system supporting 11 distinct user roles. Key features included multi-stage applicant registration, flexible rental plan management (seats, desks, offices) per branch, meeting room booking, service definition and sales, branch-specific financial reporting, and integrated support ticketing/chat. (MEAN Stack: Node.js, Express.js, Angular, MongoDB)

Developed and Enhanced Backend Services for HR & Recruitment Platforms: Contributed to the development of the Iran.hr system and significantly re-architected and upgraded a job-seeking crawler bot, improving data acquisition efficiency and coverage. (MEAN Stack)
Full-Stack Contribution in Gaming & Mobile Applications: Collaborated on the development of the mobile game “Che_Kalameh” (چ‌کلمه), applying backend skills to support game logic and data management.
Techs: JavaScript | Node.js | Express.js | MongoDB
Developed a web scraping application using Node.js to gather the latest job postings from the three leading Iranian job websites; achieved to classify and store 1000+ jobs opportunities
Designed and developed a job search engine website with filtering capabilities based on 5 specific parameters
Award 1# top student in bootcamp, Invited to join with bootcamp's mentors company to start working with them
Techs: HTML/CSS | JavaScript | Node.js | Express.js | MySQL | Git
